SELECT a.created_at AS createdAt, a.order_id AS orderId, a.bind_card_id AS bindCardId, a.trans_amt AS transAmt, b.name AS distributorName, a.operator_id AS operatorId, a.cash_status AS cashStatus, a.resp_desc AS respDesc FROM hfpay_cash_record a LEFT JOIN distribution_distributor b ON a.distributor_id = b.distributor_id
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT a.*, b.name AS distributor_name FROM hfpay_cash_record a LEFT JOIN distribution_distributor b ON a.distributor_id = b.distributor_id
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.trans_amt), 0) FROM hfpay_cash_record a
AND a.cash_status = 2

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.trans_amt), 0) FROM hfpay_cash_record a
AND a.cash_status IN (0, 1)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.trans_amt), 0) FROM hfpay_cash_record a
AND a.cash_status = 3
